call_logging_exceptions: call a behavior function and log any exceptions it raises returning an Outcome
with_exceptions_logged: wrap a callable so exceptions are logged and an Outcome is returned instead
Outcome_class: use the Outcome abstract class to represent whether a call returned or raised
Outcome_Kind_enum: check Outcome.Kind.RETURNED or Outcome.Kind.RAISED to inspect the result of a call
review_callable_util_module: review the callable_util module utilities for wrapping callables with exception logging
